check.arg: p='/var/lib/mysql/resbench_demo' want='000' got=$(stat -c '%a' "$p" 2>&1) if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then case "$got" in *ermission?denied*) echo "self-check cannot read $p (permission denied)" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac got=absent fi origin=$(awk -F: -v k="$p" '$1 == k { print $2 }' /tmp/chaos-file-chmod.tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) # 按八进制数值比，不按字符串比：stat -c '%a' 对 000 只输出 "0"，而 chaosblade 的 # --mark 必须写成 "000"（写 "0" 会报 illegal mark）；chaosblade 自己记的原始权限 # 也可能是 "0"/"00"。统一去掉前导 0（"000"→"0"，"0755"→"755"）再比。 norm_mode() { v=$1 while [ "${v#0}" != "$v" ]; do v=${v#0}; done [ -n "$v" ] || v=0 printf '%s' "$v" } got_n=$(norm_mode "$got") want_n=$(norm_mode "$want") origin_n=$(norm_mode "$origin") mode_ok=false; [ "$got_n" = "$want_n" ] && mode_ok=true not_noop=true if [ -n "$origin" ] && [ "$origin_n" = "$want_n" ]; then not_noop=false; fi enforced=false if [ "$mode_ok" = true ] && [ "$not_noop" = true ]; then enforced=true; fi if [ "$enforced" = true ]; then summary='权限已改成下发值' elif [ "$not_noop" = false ]; then summary='注入前权限本来就是该值，chmod 空转' else summary='权限仍是原值，chmod 没有生效' fi printf '{"enforced": %s, "summary": "%s", "checks": [{"name": "mode_equals_mark", "observed": "%s", "expected": "%s", "matched": %s}, {"name": "not_a_noop", "observed": "origin=%s", "expected": "origin differs from mark", "matched": %s}]}\n' \ "$enforced" "$summary" "$got" "$want" "$mode_ok" "${origin:-unknown}" "$not_noop"

dev='ens17f0' want='50' tc=/usr/sbin/tc [ -x "$tc" ] || tc=tc
stat_of() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk ' /^qdisc / { netem = ($0 ~ /netem/); next } netem && $1 == "Sent" { if (match($0, /[0-9]+ pkt/)) pkt += substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH - 4) if (match($0, /requeues [0-9]+[)]/)) hits += substr($0, RSTART + 9, RLENGTH - 10) } END { printf "%d %d\n", pkt, hits }' }
emit() { printf '{"enforced": %s, "summary": "%s", "checks": [{"name": "netem_present", "observed": "%s", "expected": "netem qdisc on %s", "matched": %s}, {"name": "traffic_through_netem", "observed": "%s", "expected": "> 0 pkt in 4s", "matched": %s}, {"name": "reorder_hits", "observed": "%s", "expected": "> 0 in 4s", "matched": %s}, {"name": "reorder_percent", "observed": "%s%%", "expected": "%s%%", "matched": %s}, {"name": "delay_positive", "observed": "%s", "expected": "> 0", "matched": %s}]}\n' \ "$enforced" "$summary" "$obs_present" "$dev" "$present_m" "$dp" "$traffic_m" "$dh" "$hits_m" "${got_pct:-unknown}" "$want" "$pct_m" "${delay:-unknown}" "$delay_m" }
s1=$("$tc" -s qdisc show dev "$dev" 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$s1" ]; then echo "self-check cannot read qdisc of $dev (tc failed: device missing or no permission)" >&2 exit 2 fi
st=$(stat_of "$s1"); p1=${st% *}; h1=${st#* } present=false case "$s1" in *"qdisc netem"*) present=true ;; esac got_pct=; delay=; p2=$p1; h2=$h1; present2=false; reset=false
if [ "$present" = true ]; then line=$(printf '%s\n' "$s1" | grep -m1 'qdisc netem') got_pct=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | awk 'match($0, /reorder [0-9.]+%/) { print substr($0, RSTART + 8, RLENGTH - 9); exit }') delay=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | awk 'match($0, /delay [0-9.]+(us|ms|s)/) { print substr($0, RSTART + 6, RLENGTH - 6); exit }') sleep 4 s2=$("$tc" -s qdisc show dev "$dev" 2>/dev/null) case "$s2" in *"qdisc netem"*) present2=true ;; esac st=$(stat_of "$s2"); p2=${st% *}; h2=${st#* } fi
dp=$((p2 - p1)); dh=$((h2 - h1)) if [ "$dp" -lt 0 ] || [ "$dh" -lt 0 ]; then dp=0; dh=0; reset=true; fi
dnum=$(printf '%s' "$delay" | sed 's/[a-z]*$//') delay_m=false if [ -n "$dnum" ] && awk -v d="$dnum" 'BEGIN { exit !(d > 0) }'; then delay_m=true; fi pct_m=false if [ -n "$got_pct" ] && awk -v a="$got_pct" -v b="$want" 'BEGIN { exit !(a == b) }'; then pct_m=true; fi traffic_m=false; [ "$dp" -gt 0 ] && traffic_m=true hits_m=false; [ "$dh" -gt 0 ] && hits_m=true obs_present=absent; [ "$present2" = true ] && obs_present=present present_m=$present2
enforced=false if [ "$present2" = true ] && [ "$traffic_m" = true ] && [ "$hits_m" = true ] && [ "$delay_m" = true ] && [ "$reset" = false ]; then enforced=true fi
root_qdisc=$(printf '%s\n' "$s1" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }') if [ "$present" = false ]; then summary="网卡 $dev 上没有 netem 规则（root qdisc 仍是 $root_qdisc）：chaosblade 的 tc qdisc add 被已存在的非默认 qdisc 挡住（File exists），注入没有挂上去" elif [ "$present2" = false ]; then summary="netem 规则在采样期间消失，注入没有持续生效" elif [ "$reset" = true ]; then summary="采样期间 netem 计数被重置（规则被重建），无法确认重排命中" elif [ "$dp" -le 0 ]; then summary="netem 已挂在 $dev 上，但 4 秒内没有报文经过（interface 可能配错，流量走的是别的网卡）" elif [ "$delay_m" = false ]; then summary="netem 的 delay 是 ${delay:-缺失}，没有时延就没有可打乱的顺序" elif [ "$dh" -le 0 ]; then summary="4 秒内有 $dp 个报文经过 netem，但没有报文被判为重排（percent 可能为 0）" else summary="netem 在 $dev 上生效：4 秒内 $dp 个报文经过，其中 $dh 个被判为重排（配置 reorder ${got_pct:-?}%）" if awk -v p="$want" 'BEGIN { exit !(p >= 80) }'; then summary="$summary；percent>=80 时对端几乎观察不到真乱序，判读请看 net.qdisc.delay" fi fi
emit
